content: Hen jisí bi huetsa sca Papan yonoti naihoh quehax botopaqueti, hihti coshi jahuen yonoti. Nai cohiman rahcotax bototi. Jahuen mapo machibi yoshin bahi joyotihcamahi. Jahuen bemanan cahen bari quescapai. Jahuen tahe cahen chihi perehihnatai quescapi.
Jan xecohi cahen quirica pishca, quehpenah sca. Bototax jahuen mecayaho tahen quebíjistima hian benichi, memiho tahen main nichí.
Nichish res sca coshin bi res quenati, hinobo sinatax coshin queoti quescari. Jan quenataiya, terenhihscai siete coti terenhihqui.
Terenhihqui tantiscaiya hen huishacatsihqui bi: —Jaa siete coti terenhihqui yohuanai huishayamahue. Tsoabi jaa yohiyamahue —naihoh quehax yohuanaiton hea jaquin.
Jeneya mai benichi yonotinin sca jahuen mecayaho mequen bochiquiri sanahihnixon:

—Jahuentianbi queyoyamanox mananicaxon ta naibo jatihibi naijanicahxon, maiyabi jano jai jatihibi jonijanicahxon, hianbo jatihibi jano jaibo jonijanicahxon Papan yohicoinihqui. Hashoan ta basitima sca jaiqui.

Jahuen siete jahuen yonotinin ta jahuen rehue hahresscanoxihquiqui. Jahuen rehue jan hahmenohiya ta Papan joi yohinicabaan yohini quesca sca jaresscatihiqui, Papan jato yohini jayaxihquibo jaresscanon —hahquin jeneya mai benichiton.
Hean nincacah naihoh quehax yohuanrihbihi: —Hoa jeneya mai benichi yonotinin xecohi bihtanhue, quehpenah quirica pishca —hea jaquin.

Caxon sca: —Miin quirica pishca hea hinanhue —hean jaa yonoti jaquin. —Bihhue. Bihxon piquin queyobahinhue. Miin poco janin cachapi hihnon bi ta min piha hihti batatihiqui, bonajene tiho batapi —hahxon jahuen quirica pishca hea hinanquin.
Hinanah, bihxon pihá bi hihcoini bonajene tiho batapi. Piquin queyobahinah sca cahen heen poco janin cachascai.
—Hicha jonibo, huetsa mai mehabo, huetsa joiyahpabo, jaton quiquin hapoboyabi tah min hicha jonibo pari jato yohiti jai —hea jaquin.
